raw.rationale: LCL-161 is a SMAC mimetic that degrades cIAP1/XIAP and kills only a small subset of cancer lines, typically those with autocrine TNF and caspase-8/RIPK1 competence; PRISM single-agent screens show rare, lineage-restricted activity rather than broad selectivity. Published PRISM/CTRP data indicate the strongest selective signals in a few hematologic and solid lineages, with lung and skin among the more frequently responsive solid lineages, while most lineages remain near baseline.
